scripts.build-test.py:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,concurrent.futures,json,hashlib
out=Path.cwd()/'.work/stack-check-20261116'
jobs=[('baseline','windows-debug',['zig','build','test','--summary','all']),('candidate','windows-debug',['zig','build','test','--summary','all']),('candidate','linux-symbols',['zig','build','-Dtarget=x86_64-linux-musl','-Doptimize=fast','-Dcpu=baseline','-Dstrip=false','--prefix',str(out/'candidate-symbols'),'--summary','all'])]
def run(job):
 kind,name,cmd=job
 with (out/(kind+'-'+name+'.log')).open('wb') as f:p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=out/kind,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
 row={'kind':kind,'name':name,'command':cmd,'exit':p.returncode};assert p.returncode==0,row;print(kind,name,'passed',flush=True);return row
# Separate baseline/candidate cache; candidate jobs sequential.
rows=[]
with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
 rows=list(pool.map(run,jobs[:2]))
rows.append(run(jobs[2]));(out/'validation-initial.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
scripts.check-windows-direct.py:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,json,hashlib,shutil
r=Path.cwd();o=r/'.work/stack-check-20261116';rows=[]
for kind in ['baseline','candidate']:
 for i,p in enumerate((o/kind/'.zig-cache/o').glob('*/test.exe')):
  cmd=[str(p)]
  with (o/f'{kind}-windows-direct-{i}.log').open('wb') as f:x=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=o/kind,stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  assert x.returncode==0;rows.append({'kind':kind,'command':cmd,'exit':x.returncode,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()})
(o/'windows-direct-tests.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n');print('direct test binaries passed',len(rows))
